items.title: Are Strong Earnings Altering The Investment Case For Altria Stock (MO)?
items.summary: Altria Group reported third quarter 2026 sales of US$5,441 million and net income of US$2,518 million, with earnings per share from continuing operations of US$1.51. The company also extended its multidecade streak of dividend increases and continued share repurchases. The combination of higher earnings, ongoing cash returns and growth in the on! nicotine pouch brand highlights how Altria Group is leaning on smoke free products and capital allocation to support its tobacco focused business...
